chapter.title: Upgrading &productname;

info.meta: Learn what upgrade and migration paths for &productname; are supported and upgrade your system to the latest version

chapter.para: When planning to upgrade your operating system to a new Service Pack or perform a major release migration, you must verify the supported upgrade paths for &productname;.

listitem.para: The supported upgrade and offline migration paths for &productname; are identical to the supported paths for &sls; with Enhanced Service Pack Overlay Support (ESPOS).
If an upgrade path from your current Service Pack to a target Service Pack is supported for &sls; with ESPOS, it is fully supported for your &productnameshort; environment.

chapter.para: Detailed explanation of all currently supported migration paths is maintained in a centralized &slsa; &upgrade_guide;.
To determine if your specific version upgrade is supported, find the detailed information in the &slsa; &upgrade_guide; at: .
